long_biography.plain_text:
Kamel Alzarka's move into art finance let collectors borrow against paintings without necessarily surrendering them. Falcon Fine Art offered this arrangement in England and Wales, where eligible works could remain with their owners. Led by art specialist Tim Hunter, the division concentrated initially on established artists and assessed how readily pictures could be resold. The business was sold to The Fine Art Group in 2019.

Alzarka described delegation as central to managing his wider business. He gave colleagues responsibility while insisting that he understand their work closely enough to direct it. He also preferred structuring transactions around each customer's needs rather than fitting customers into a fixed set of products.
